items.raw_excerpt: 2025年，从阿里巴巴离职的语音专家鄢志杰，正面临一个重要抉择。 鄢志杰 一边是急于在AI领域大展拳脚的京东，其研究院正招兵买马，尤其从阿里、商汤、百度等企业招揽英才；另一边是腾讯的AI Lab团队，俞栋团队也正在寻找一位值得信赖的语音领域顶尖人才。 当时，早就有意亲自管理京东研究院的刘强东求贤若渴，甚至直接与鄢志杰会面，希望将这位通义实验室语音团队的前负责人招入麾下，最终却被鄢志杰婉拒。 鄢志杰婉拒老刘的原因，并非腾讯AI Lab给出的待遇优厚——在他心中，俞栋是自己在微软时期的同事，这份情谊重逾千钧。 俞栋 于是，鄢志杰义无反顾地加入了俞栋的团队。 天有不测风云， 鄢志杰到岗时，俞栋麾下语音团队已经开始跟混元团队合作，共同开发对标豆包语音的项目——“混元-O”，此时混元团队研发任务紧张，语音+视觉理解的团队已成建制，项目已经在跑起来了。 人员调动，刚入职腾讯的鄢志杰也受到了影响。一说鄢志杰本人被调到混元，无法和俞栋“双剑合璧”；一说鄢志杰的团队被调走了一批人，而把鄢和一个三五个人的小团队留在了 AI Lab。 然而，“混元-O”项目的开发却并不顺利。由于缺乏语音数据，团队巧妇难为无米之炊，最终的训练结果自然不及预期。 这也在一定程度上导致了鄢志杰入职仅3个月便离开腾讯，转而加入京东研究院。 再之后，俞栋也在各种组织变动之下离职。俞栋走后，AI Lab 的三剑客正式全部离开了腾讯，这也为后来AI Lab的撤销埋下了伏笔。 不难发现，AI 大模型的出现，直接地挑战着互联网大厂的组织架构。 当 Transformer 架构一统语言、视觉、声音等能力，当大量算力不得不向尖端部门集中，当技术的迭代开始以周为单位计算…… 面临历史的浪潮，腾讯该何去何从？ （腾讯的 AI Lab 往事，雷峰网仍在持续跟进中，欢迎添加作者微信：william_dong，交流爆料。) 01 张正友时代：

excerpt_i18n.en: As early as March, Zuo Fei, a colleague working on Tencent Hunyuan, told Leiphone that expectations for the upcoming Hunyuan 3.0 were not particularly high within the team. A month later, on the evening of April 23, the Preview version of Hy3 was officially released and open-sourced, showcasing its true form to the world. Leiphone exclusively learned that the closed-source flagship version of Hy3, with larger scale and more comprehensive features, will be released in May or June, leaving room for imagination. (Leiphone continues to follow the latest developments of Tencent Hunyuan. Feel free to add the author's WeChat: william_dong to exchange information and insights.) Speaking of which, the release of Tencent Hy3 Preview was somewhat ill-timed—sandwiched between the global attention on GPT 5.5 and the significant return of DeepSeek V4, Hunyuan still stumbled on the elementary math problem "9.7 minus 9.11," sparking a stir on social platforms. "Actually, the release dates of GPT and DeepSeek are no secret within our team, but I'm not sure why we chose to release alongside them at this time," Zuo Fei told Leiphone. What changes does Hy3 bring compared to the previous version from four months ago? Tai Luo, a colleague within Hunyuan, shared with Leiphone: "Hy3 essentially restructured the previous architecture, but simply put, it returned to the basics."
excerpt_i18n.es: Ya en marzo, al mencionar el próximo lanzamiento de Hunyuan 3.0, Zuo Fei, un colega que trabaja en Tencent Hunyuan, le dijo a Leiphone: "En esta nueva versión de Hunyuan, el equipo no tiene expectativas muy altas". Un mes después, en la noche del 23 de abril, se lanzó oficialmente la versión Preview de Hy3, con código abierto sincronizado, mostrando al mundo su aspecto más auténtico. Leiphone supo en exclusiva que la versión insignia cerrada de Hy3, de mayor escala y funciones más completas, se lanzará en mayo o junio, dejando mucho espacio para la imaginación. A New Landscape and New Paradigm

This is not merely an iterative upgrade of research tools but a fundamental reshaping of scientific thinking and underlying paradigms.

excerpt_i18n.en: Lei Feng Net News: Users have long suffered from the high cost of tokens. "I burned through thousands of dollars worth of tokens, but the Agent still didn't finish the job." This is perhaps the most embarrassing and common situation faced by the early adopters of "raising shrimp." As Agents increasingly take over workflows, people are starting to see efficiency issues when weighing the results. excerpt_i18n.en: Lei Feng Net News - Whether viewed from the broad trajectory of technology or the immediate commercial applications, video models are currently one of the hottest tracks. As a result, every new video model released today faces increasingly stringent scrutiny from both academia and industry. Recently, this attention has been directed at Alibaba's newly launched Happy Horse-1.0. As the debut work of Alibaba's ATH business group in the video model track, this "dark horse" immediately ranked first and second on the authoritative blind testing platforms Arena and Artificial Analysis upon its release. Of course, for a track that has already entered deep waters, the significance of benchmarks and leaderboards is becoming increasingly limited. The more pressing issue is practical application. When various models can effortlessly produce stunning visuals like "cyberpunk city nightscapes" or "ancient-style women holding umbrellas and looking back," the production mode of video content has undergone a revolution. The rapid expansion of the AI short drama and comic drama markets is a prime example. However, while many content creators envision a bright future for "vibe videos," the other side of reality is that blockbuster works of the caliber of "Paper Phone" remain rare. Often, what we see is more like dynamic PPTs pieced together from continuous short videos, with fragmented narratives either forced together by voiceovers or left entirely to the audience's imagination. From a technical perspective, this can be explained as video models still having significant shortcomings in multi-shot scheduling, character expressiveness, and complex motion.

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng News: China's world model team has achieved another success. Shengshu Technology, led by Zhu Jun, announced the completion of a nearly 2 billion yuan Series B financing round. This round was led by Alibaba Cloud, with strategic investments from China Netcom Investment, Jiuan Haitang, Tomorrow Advancing Life, and Guanghe Venture Capital. Existing shareholders, including Xinglian Capital, Data Capital, C&D Emerging Investment, Baidu BV Venture Capital, and Zhuoyuan Asia, continued to increase their investments. This marks Shengshu Technology's second major financing in 2026, just two months after its over 600 million yuan Series A+ round led by Zhongguancun Science City Company and Xinglian Capital. Founded in March 2023, Shengshu Technology gained fame with the release of its video model Vidu in April 2024, China's first text-to-video model fully comparable to Sora. On January 30, 2026, Vidu was upgraded to the Q3 version, achieving up to 16 seconds of synchronized audio and video, supporting multi-shot transitions, camera control, BGM and sound effects generation, and multilingual dialogue. After its release, Vidu Q3 ranked first globally in the list published by Artificial Analysis, an international authoritative AI benchmark institution. It is now deployed across industries such as internet, advertising and marketing, animation and film, education, and cultural tourism. In the AGI vision, video models are unique because their pursuit of physical realism aligns with the goals of general world models.
excerpt_i18n.es: Noticias de Leifeng: El equipo chino de modelos mundiales vuelve a lograr un éxito. Shengshu Technology, liderada por Zhu Jun, anunció la finalización de una ronda de financiación Serie B de casi 2.000 millones de yuanes. Esta ronda está liderada por Alibaba Cloud, con inversiones estratégicas de China Net Investment, Jiu'an Haitang, Haoxuexi, Guanghe Venture Capital y otros inversores. Los accionistas existentes, como Xinglian Capital, Datai Capital, Jianfa Emerging Investment, Baidu BV Venture Capital y Zhuoyuan Asia, continúan realizando inversiones adicionales. Esta es ya la segunda gran ronda de financiación que Shengshu Technology obtiene en 2026, apenas dos meses después de la ronda Serie A+ de más de 600 millones de yuanes liderada por Zhongguancun Science City Company y Xinglian Capital. Shengshu Technology se fundó en 2023.
